prompt: Make a 7 slide educational carousel for Terra Ledger, a property advisory firm in Pune. Topic: '5 things to check on the RERA website before you book a flat'. Audience is first-time home buyers aged 28-38. Brand is calm and trustworthy, navy and sand colours, they want people to save it. No photos, keep it graphic. Final slide should push them to DM 'RERA' for a free checklist.
assertions: Exactly 7 slide images are rendered as PNG files in a 4:5 (1080x1350) format
Slide 1 is a hook cover and slides 2-6 each cover one distinct thing to check on the RERA website
The final slide asks people to DM 'RERA' for the free checklist
The design uses no photographs (graphic only) in a navy and sand palette
A caption and per-slide alt text are provided in files
No body text on any slide is smaller than 24 px at 1080 px width (excluding legal/micro text)
